title: Wall Street Slides as Alphabet's AI Cash Burn Spooks Investors
en: US stocks fell on Thursday as investors reassessed the cost of Big Tech's artificial intelligence spending spree. The Nasdaq Composite dropped 1.66% to 26,108, the S&P 500 lost 0.63% and the Dow slipped 0.59%. Alphabet was the heaviest drag, sliding 13.2% after quarterly revenue missed estimates and free cash flow turned negative at 9.07 billion dollars, wiping roughly 479 billion dollars off its market value. Communication services slumped 6.6%, the worst of eleven sectors. Small caps, by contrast, gained 0.8%, a sign that investors still see value outside the AI trade. Roughly 81% of S&P 500 companies reporting so far have beaten forecasts.
zh: 周四美股下跌，投资者重新评估大型科技公司人工智能巨额投入的成本。纳斯达克综合指数跌1.66%至26108点，标普500指数跌0.63%，道指跌0.59%。Alphabet跌幅最大，下挫13.2%，此前其季度营收不及预期，自由现金流转为负90.7亿美元，市值蒸发约4790亿美元。通信服务板块重挫6.6%，在十一个板块中表现最差。相比之下，小盘股上涨0.8%，显示投资者仍认为AI交易之外存在机会。目前已公布业绩的标普500公司中约81%超出预期。
vocab: n. 大手笔支出、疯狂采购

title: Fed Holds Rates as Inflation Runs Hot Again
en: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate in a range of 3.75% to 4% on Wednesday, a widely expected pause that was far from unanimous. The vote was 10 to 2, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack preferring a quarter-point increase. Policymakers called price pressures elevated and said they would gather more information before their next move. Data a day later showed why: September headline PCE inflation rose 3.6% from a year earlier, the fastest since May, while core PCE climbed 3.1%. Third-quarter GDP grew at a 3.4% annualised pace. Traders now price more than an 81% chance of a December hike.
zh: 美联储周三将基准利率维持在3.75%至4%区间，这一被广泛预期的暂停远非一致通过。投票结果为10比2，理事莉萨·库克与克利夫兰联储行长贝丝·哈玛克主张加息25个基点。决策者称价格压力偏高，并表示将在下次行动前收集更多信息。次日公布的数据说明了原因：9月整体PCE通胀同比上涨3.6%，为5月以来最快，核心PCE上涨3.1%。三季度GDP按年率计算增长3.4%。交易员目前认为12月加息概率超过81%。
vocab: n. 整体通胀（未经剔除）
phr. 计入价格、反映预期

title: Spain Mourns 69 Dead After Its Worst Rail Disaster in a Decade
en: Spain began three days of mourning on Thursday for the 69 people killed when two high-speed trains collided near the town of Urda, south of Madrid. A train operated by the state-owned Renfe struck the rear of a privately run Iryo service that had stopped on the same line from Madrid to Andalucia, knocking carriages down an embankment. About 540 people were on board. Officials said 110 were taken to hospital and 50 were still being treated. Transport Minister Oscar Puente said the LZB signalling system failed around 8.30am because of a computer fault, halting trains along some 63 kilometres of track, and that a control centre then wrongly ordered them to resume.
zh: 西班牙周四开始为期三天的哀悼，悼念在马德里以南乌尔达镇附近两列高铁相撞事故中遇难的69人。一列由国有西班牙国家铁路公司运营的列车追尾了停在马德里至安达卢西亚同一线路上的私营伊尔约公司列车，导致车厢冲下路堤。车上约有540人。官员称110人被送往医院，其中50人仍在接受治疗。交通大臣奥斯卡·普恩特表示，LZB信号系统因电脑故障于上午8时30分左右失效，导致约63公里路段上的列车停驶，随后一个调度中心错误地下令恢复运行。

title: UN Assembly Votes 130 to 17 to End the Cuba Embargo
en: The UN General Assembly adopted a resolution on Wednesday calling for an end to the decades-old US economic embargo on Cuba, by 130 votes to 17 with 25 abstentions. It was the 34th consecutive year the assembly has passed such a text. The resolution expresses concern about laws with extraterritorial effects, including the 1996 Helms-Burton Act, and urges states that apply them to repeal or invalidate them. Support slipped from last year, when the vote was 165 to 7 with 12 abstentions, and Germany, Italy and Latvia abstained for the first time. Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez called the result a new victory and said Cuba is not a threat, the embargo is.
zh: 联合国大会周三通过决议，以130票赞成、17票反对、25票弃权呼吁终止美国对古巴实施数十年的经济封锁。这是联大连续第34年通过此类文件。决议对具有域外效力的法律表示关切，包括1996年的《赫尔姆斯-伯顿法》，并敦促实施此类法律的国家予以撤销或废止。支持率较去年下滑，当时为165票赞成、7票反对、12票弃权，德国、意大利和拉脱维亚首次投下弃权票。古巴外长布鲁诺·罗德里格斯称这一结果是新的胜利，并表示古巴不是威胁，封锁才是。

title: Samsung Posts a Record Quarter as AI Chips Tighten Their Grip
en: Samsung Electronics reported third-quarter operating profit of 107.4 trillion won, up 783% from a year earlier, becoming the first technology company to clear 100 trillion won in a single quarter. Revenue reached 195.25 trillion won, a record, and net profit rose 514.6% to 75.13 trillion won. The semiconductor division generated 106.5 trillion won of operating profit on 147.1 trillion won of sales, helped by strong demand for HBM4 memory and server solid-state drives, while the devices division posted a loss of 0.8 trillion won. The company plans capital spending of about 84.4 trillion won this year. Even so, shares fell more than 5% because profit narrowly missed estimates.
zh: 三星电子公布第三季度营业利润107.4万亿韩元，同比增长783%，成为首家单季营业利润突破100万亿韩元的科技企业。营收达195.25万亿韩元，创历史新高；净利润增长514.6%至75.13万亿韩元。半导体部门在147.1万亿韩元销售额上实现营业利润106.5万亿韩元，得益于HBM4存储与服务器固态硬盘的强劲需求；整机部门则亏损0.8万亿韩元。公司今年计划资本支出约84.4万亿韩元。即便如此，因利润略低于预期，其股价仍下跌超过5%。
vocab: v. 突破、超过（某个数值）

title: Apple Puts a Touchscreen on the Mac for the First Time
en: Apple has unveiled its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen, ending a product philosophy it had defended for nearly two decades. The 14-inch and 16-inch models use a tandem OLED display Apple calls PROLED XDR, with peak brightness of 2,000 nits and a 120Hz refresh rate, and they bring the Dynamic Island to the Mac for the first time. They run on M5 Pro or M5 Max chips, support up to 128GB of unified memory and 16TB of storage, and Apple says the top model can run language models with hundreds of billions of parameters on the device itself. Battery life reaches 24 hours. Prices start at 22,999 yuan in China, with sales from November 6.
zh: 苹果发布首款配备触控屏的MacBook Pro，终结了其坚持近二十年的产品理念。14英寸与16英寸机型采用苹果称为PROLED XDR的双层串联OLED显示屏，峰值亮度2000尼特，刷新率120Hz，并首次将灵动岛引入Mac。新机搭载M5 Pro或M5 Max芯片，最高支持128GB统一内存与16TB存储，苹果称顶配机型可在设备本地运行参数规模达数千亿的大语言模型。续航最长可达24小时。中国大陆起售价22999元，11月6日开售。
